items.title: Two-year plan
items.description: The route through our six units, the research practicals and the assessment.

items.title: Syllabus checklist
items.description: Every examinable term and objective, by unit. Tick each one off as you master it.

title: Psychology as a Way of Thinking
question: How do psychologists develop, test and evaluate explanations of behaviour?

title: Learning, Bias and Decision-Making
question: How do we learn, and why do our judgements go wrong?

items.title: Escape the Loop: Operant Conditioning
items.description: An escape room on reinforcement, punishment and schedules, and how they change behaviour.

items.title: Two Minds: Dual Processing and Cognitive Biases
items.description: Ten group stations: experience a bias, trace it to System 1 and System 2, then teach it.

title: Memory, Models and the Brain
question: How can we explain memory, investigate the brain and improve cognition?

items.title: Memory Lab: Models of Memory
items.description: The Multi-Store Model and Working Memory Model, with the evidence that tests them.

items.title: Memory Quest: Working Memory and Cognitive Load
items.description: A voiced story lab: test your working memory, replicate two studies and meet cognitive load theory.

items.title: Neural Lab: From Signals to Memory
items.description: Neurotransmission, a rat-maze study of acetylcholine and memory, and how drugs act at the synapse.

items.title: Memory Olympiad: Improving Memory
items.description: Six memory challenges with new material every attempt. Try a strategy and see what it changes.

items.title: Odyssey: Learning and Cognition Review
items.description: A voiced, branching adventure that reviews Units 2 and 3 for Paper 1, with study and exam modes.

items.title: Mindvault: Learning and Cognition Escape Room
items.description: Nine rooms of quick questions on Units 2 and 3, then a notes workshop.

title: Influence, Identity and Connection
question: How do groups and personal relationships shape behaviour?

title: Mental Health, Behaviour Change and Culture
question: How are mental health and health problems explained, addressed and prevented?

title: Development Across Time
question: How and why do people develop, and what shapes their sense of self?

title: Exam practice
question: Timed writing and paper practice that runs across units.

items.title: Redemption Arc: Paper 1 Section C
items.description: A supervised rewrite of a Paper 1 Section C essay, submitted as a PDF.
